responsibility: Proves that every declared derived view regenerates byte-identically from unchanged authority and that regeneration itself writes nothing.
reads: all append-only authority tables through AuthorityStore.query
mutation_interface: none — it constructs fresh read models, hashes their JSON-safe values, and returns an ephemeral proof
execution_location: in-process, offline, over one clean-room authority handle
failure_boundary: fail_closed — an incomplete inventory, a missing surface, unequal hashes from two fresh builds, a write during regeneration, or an unsafe authority table name refuses the proof
recovery_behavior: Stateless and read-only; rerun from authority, and compare surface_set_hash across a reopened store for cold-start equivalence
replacement_contract: A replacement must enumerate every manifest-declared projection, construct each view twice through fresh projection instances, compare canonical hashes, hash all authority before between and after, persist no view or proof, and fail closed on any omission mutation or mismatch
evidence_produced: one ephemeral RegenerationProof naming the complete inventory and one canonical hash per surface
one surface_set_hash suitable for cold-start comparison
one authority_digest proven identical before between and after both regeneration passes
one proof_hash binding the gate identity inventory surface set authority digest and pass count
